scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.export:githubpage: npm run build -w frontend && cp -r frontend/dist/* githubpage/ && cp frontend/dist/index.html githubpage/404.html && touch githubpage/.nojekyll
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build -w frontend && npx gh-pages -d frontend/dist
